# How Do I Manage Commissions for Partners and Real Estate Agents?


You manage partner commissions by calculating each one automatically from the reservation or contract that generated it, then routing it through the same approval flow as any other expense. On **Jestor** , this connects partner data to commission rules and native **ERP** integration.


Calculating commissions manually for multiple partners, each possibly with different terms, is an administrative task prone to error that grows in complexity with volume.


## What manual commission calculation risks


- Calculation errors when applying different commission rates manually
- No clear connection between a commission and the specific reservation or contract that generated it
- Delayed commission payments due to manual processing
- No visibility for the partner into how their commission was calculated


## How structured commission management works


- Each partner has a commission rate connected to their record
- Commission can be calculated automatically from the relevant reservation or contract
- Calculated commissions pass through the same approval flow as any expense
- Approved commissions enter **Omie** or **Conta Azul** directly


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- Automatic calculation removes the risk of manual error across different commission rates
- Connection to the originating reservation or contract gives full traceability
- Native ERP integration removes manual re-entry of the payment
- Scales from a few partners to a large network without redesign


Manual calculation Structured commission management


Error-prone, manually applied rates Calculated automatically, connected data


## Frequently Asked Questions


**Can different partners have different commission rates?** Yes, each partner can have their own rate connected to their record. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Does the commission connect to the specific reservation that generated it?** Yes, maintaining full traceability.


**Does this enter the ERP automatically once approved?** Yes, through native Omie or Conta Azul integration.
